title: Queens That Can Attack The King
description:
On an 8 by 8 chessboard, return each queen that can directly attack the king along a rank, file, or diagonal, with no other queen between them. Return coordinates sorted lexicographically by row then column.

## Examples

```text
Input: queens = [[0,1],[1,0],[4,0],[0,4],[3,3],[2,4]], king = [0,0]
Output: [[0,1],[1,0],[3,3]]
```

```text
Input: queens = [[0,0],[1,1],[2,2],[3,4],[3,5],[4,4],[4,5]], king = [3,3]
Output: [[2,2],[3,4],[4,4]]
```

## Constraints

- There are 1..63 queens and one king
- All positions are distinct and have row and column in `[0,7]`
